hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Prediction market hook implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) fees for YES/NO share token pools. Every swap requires a signed sigma parameter in hookData; the hook computes an exponential fee from trade size, liquidity, and the signed toxic-velocity value, takes the fee from the USDC (collateral) side via BeforeSwapDelta, and distributes it to share token holders through a YieldDistributor contract. Swaps are blocked when the market is resolved or disputed.
